name: Classic
description: A grey strip with a line at its left, name and text in one line

name: Colour card
description: The name in bold in that person's colour, the text below, and a small picture when it answers a photo

name: Mini bubble
description: A small bubble in the colour of the original, with the first letter of the name

name: Above the message
description: Floats small above the bubble, joined to it by a curved line

name: Quote marks
description: A big quote mark, the text in italics, signed with the name

name: Bubble header
description: The top of the bubble, edge to edge, a shade darker

name: Dart
description: A thin frame in the person's colour and a dart pointing at the name
